profile.headline: Software Engineer | React | Angular | Go Lang

positions.title: Software Engineer L3
positions.description:
●	Increased significant number of orders via the web by designing new UI logic with React, led users much faster place orders with new products.
●	Avoided PCI penalties by designing new UI flows in-app by using React and Angular, therefore completely retiring old legacy applications.  
●	Reduced amount to pay each transaction by designing new UI logic to integrate a new payment gateway based on using Angular framework and Rxjs library.
●	Increased time to consuming data by building new service with Go lang, therefore was able to retire old service. 
●	The decreased average number of production errors by roughly 5% by applying SRP, UI best practices, and peep mentoring.

company.name: Missouri University of Science and Technology

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Reduced 15-20% time for gathering data by developing REST API, leading to a 10% reduction in searching time of internal customers.
    • Collaborated with team to leverage 20% MasterCard API resources and exploring 15-20% new customers
    • Increased optimizing big data time by 20% by using ETL process, leading to increase 5-10% the automation process for getting external data

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
•	Created full stack web application for reducing approximately 30% chance of accidents or lost from visitors and truck drivers by using C#/JavaScript/MVC/MapTiler
•	Created templates JS classes and documentations to reduce from 20-30% times for creating new applications
•	Collaborated with diverse departments and employees to build optimized routes for the project using Scrum master 
•	Fixed the major issue about departments allocation with Safety Department by using Java Script/HTML/CSS

company.name: Missouri University of Science and Technology

positions.title: R&D intern
positions.description:
•	Created a website application to help Consultant automatically optimizes and defines each transaction of bank’s customers from 3 to 10 years by using SQL/C#/MVC.
•	Helped team to build a windows application to save quality assurance’s time for corrected daily bugs from testing process by using C#.
•	Collaborated with R&D and human resources departments for helping to creating the monthly team huddle event

positions.title: Web Specialist
positions.description:
•	Worked and connected with team from different areas, time zones.
•	Fixed bugs on website and make sure it works properly and quickly.
•	Built new behaviors up on website to attract more visitors.

positions.title: IT Helpdesk
positions.description:
• Installed and maintained all desktop computers, networking, and commutation equipment
• Provided user support to local employees and students via personal visits
